title: himantoglossum caprinum subsp. calcaratum
intro: Himantoglossum caprinum subsp. calcaratum, commonly known as the Italian orchid or Italian himantoglossum, is a species of orchid native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Himantoglossum caprinum subsp. calcaratum include expectorant, anti-catarrhal, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for soothing respiratory issues and relieving congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
